question_cn: 马对通路兵，马能否阻止兵升变主要取决于：
question_en: Knight vs. passed pawn — whether the knight can stop promotion mainly depends on:

options.text_cn: 马能否在兵升变前赶到阻挡位置
options.text_en: Whether the knight can reach a blocking square before the pawn promotes

options.text_cn: 马比兵快，所以总能阻止
options.text_en: Knight is faster than a pawn so it always stops it

options.text_cn: 马比兵慢，所以总是阻止不了
options.text_en: Knight is slower so it can never stop it
Depends only on the enemy king position

explanation_cn: 马对通路兵的元思维：马的路径是L形的，有时捷径很长。需要计算马能否在N步内到达阻挡格，而不是凭感觉判断。这是马残局精确计算的训练重点。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: knight moves in L-shapes, so distances can be deceptive. Always calculate whether the knight can reach the blocking square in time — don't rely on intuition.
